chunks.text: Welcome to the Slow English Podcast.
In this podcast, we speak slowly.
Today, we travel to Eastern Europe.
Ukraine is a large country in Europe.
It is in the east of Europe.
Part three, Lviv is in the west of Ukraine.
It is near other European countries.
The city is not near the sea.
It is not in the desert.
The seasons change the city's mood.
Part five, a city with long history.
Lviv has a very long history.
People lived here many centuries ago.
The city changed rulers many times, but the city kept its spirit.
The heart of Lviv is the old town.
It is a UNESCO World Heritage site.
Old town feels like a museum, but people live here every day.
The center of the old town is market square.
Coffee is part of daily life.
Cafes are part of the culture.
Part nine, daily life in Lviv.
Daily life in Lviv is calm.
In the morning streets are quiet.
In the evening streets are full.
Food in Lviv is warm and traditional.
Art is part of daily life.
Lviv is a city of history, coffee, culture and calm life.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
See you in the next episode.
